title: Multiplexed Streaming & Tool-call Compatibility Test Matrix
creator: Liam O'Connor
description: Build a deterministic, maintainable conformance matrix and automated regression harness that validates streaming APIs, tool/function-calling behavior, and structured-output compatibility across model variants and deployment modes (hosted, dedicated, private). The goal is to catch behavioral regressions early in CI and provide clear signaling for rollouts and fallbacks. This ticket covers specification, golden prompt corpus, fingerprinting strategy, CI gating rules, and initial implementation of the test runner and reporting dashboards.
acceptance_criteria: Define an explicit test matrix mapping API features (streaming, chunk ordering, partial tool calls, final tool invocation) to expected behaviors for each supported model family and quantization profile

Create a golden prompt corpus of >= 120 prompts focusing on edge cases (interleaved tool calls, long prefix streaming, function arguments with nested JSON, abort/resume), with deterministic seeds and expected canonical outputs or match predicates
Implement a CI job that runs a fast smoke conformance suite on PRs and a nightly full-regression run; PR failures must block merges for runtime-*.x releases
Add a compatibility shim test that verifies fallback semantics (model variant substitution, region fallback) and records divergence metrics (token-level edit distance, semantic similarity)
Expose per-test failure tags in the Console dashboard with links to replay artifacts, logs, and a reproducible run command
notes: This ticket focuses on reliability of behavioral compatibility, not on perf microbenchmarks. We will reuse existing streaming CI infrastructure where possible but add explicit checks for tool-call boundaries and structured-output schema validation. Golden corpus will be versioned and signed to prevent accidental drift.
